scope: Variable-size homogeneous Minvoice cash batches, mock target 300; OneCA app integration
accepted_behavior: One REST login/bootstrap and approval scope for batch
All invoice serials checked before any upload
Prior group ACK before next download
Multiple GUID XML entries and aggregate HDon; counts distinct
All XML signed and verified before each group upload
Upload group 2 timeout/cancel: 100 ACK, 100 uncertain, 100 not started
Signing/verification group 2 failure: no upload 2 or group 3
Menu cancel closes PIN and releases signing lock
One PIN prompt per command; reference cleared on terminal paths; helper login/sign/logout per XML
CRC, path/name/duplicate/size checks; bounded in-memory ZIP
benchmark_limits: Standalone software-only test process; 800 ms group delay disabled. Not backend/network/token performance or real app peak memory.
live_limits: No live300 signing or issuance performed
Existing live evidence covers Windows cash1/3
Ordinary and mixed serial batches unsupported
Upload ACK is not independent tax issuance/chain validation
Invoice GUID to HDon content mapping supplied by backend, not independently established
